summary: Python terminal wrapper for legacy exact-cover Quick Dev plan; requires repository root, plan directory, and output path arguments; reads implementation contract and command registry JSON; runs terminal validation subprocess from repository root; collects all red/green command IDs from contract slices and checks registry coverage; failures are validation nonzero or command-registry drift; emits implementation-complete receipt result with schema version, plan ID, pass/fail status, failure list, contract and registry SHA-256 digests, terminal command ID, validated IDs, authorization only on pass, lifecycle transition none, and terminal stdout digest; on pass publishes canonical receipt under repair/round-1 with conflict-safe successor naming; writes requested output JSON and exits success only when no failures
